description: In the Alice Mburu wrap-up brief (meetings/Alice Mburu - 2026-10-09.md), Shep flagged a travel-booking discrepancy: it read the Oct 9 Teams thread (hotel 'till Tuesday', Wednesday departure, Sunday arrival options around a social opening) as conflicting with the Houston Oct 13-15 booking and told David to VERIFY before ticketing. David corrected: the morning thread was about a Miami trip, not Houston. There was no discrepancy; two different trips were conflated.
correction: The Sunday-arrival thread belongs to a Miami trip; the Houston booking stands exactly as the calendar shows. When a travel thread does not match a calendar entry, consider that it may belong to a different trip before declaring a discrepancy and asking the executive to reconcile it.
systemic_fix: Proposed for one-on-one-prep / travel-thread handling: before surfacing a travel discrepancy, enumerate known upcoming trips and attempt to match the thread to any of them; if ambiguous, present it as 'thread does not match Houston dates — possibly a different trip (Miami?)' rather than as a booking error to fix.
